lines.text: God tells Aaron to bring the Levites from his father's tribe to assist him, but they must not touch the altar.
God gives the Levites to Aaron as a gift, and only Aaron and his sons serve as priests inside the veil.
God gives Aaron the offerings, and a month-old firstborn son is redeemed for ten shekels of silver.
God tells Aaron that the land is his inheritance, and the Levites receive all the tithes in Israel.

wrong_details.true: the LORD is his portion and inheritance, with no inheritance in the land

lines.text: The LORD tells Moses that the Levites must give a tithe of the tithe, from the best, to Aaron the priest.
